scope_notes: NSEvent age is measured at an early pointer probe after the host marker; adding it to handler time contains a small overlapping probe interval and is an upper estimate, not input-to-photon latency.
All four trials use separate processes, the same binary and 9 warmed surfaces, off/on/on/off order. No builds run during timing.
Rust main-process CPU/RSS exclude WebView, WindowServer and total driver VRAM. A1 has lower background cadence/higher CPU than A2; no causal CPU or FPS gain is claimed.
16 zoom cycles/32 presents per trial, first 4 dropped, 28 retained per trial/56 per mode. Longer 60-second x5 acceptance and real pen input remain unfinished.
